title: Settle stale worktrees from durable evidence so the status census keeps meaning what it says
description:
A live smoke test of the new status census found worktrees still registered under .herdr/worktrees for tick 19l attempts 18-19, tick cwa attempt 7 and tick h0f attempt 14 - hours to days old. These are runs whose teardown never ran: the killed-writer pattern the learnings already record.

They are honest input to the gap surface, but they accumulate, and an operator reading the census cannot tell a live attempt from a months-old corpse. The settlement should come from durable evidence rather than from a timeout: is the attempt collected? is its branch merged or its marker settled? If so the worktree is a leftover and can be reported as such (and removed), whatever its age.

Found by the 7zs worker (run epic-9pd, tick 7zs, attempt 22).
acceptance_criteria: The census distinguishes standing worktrees whose attempt is settled from those whose attempt is live, deciding from the attempt record rather than from age, and a test covers a leftover worktree whose attempt was collected.
